name: kit
description: @rabjs/kit skills for coding agents: using-rabjs-kit (when to use kit vs native APIs), adding-kit-function (how to add a public function), migrating-lodash-to-kit (replace lodash).
skillInstructions:
kit skills tool mapping for Kimi Code:

- When a kit skill refers to fetching a URL or fetching documentation, use Kimi Code's `FetchURL` tool; when it asks to search the web, use `WebSearch`.
- When a kit skill asks to run shell commands (pnpm test, pnpm build, pnpm docs:catalog), use `Bash`.
- When a kit skill asks to read or edit project files, use `Read`, `Write`, `Edit`, `Grep`, and `Glob` by their actual exposed names.
- Invoke kit skills with Kimi Code's native `Skill` tool.

interface.longDescription: Use @rabjs/kit skills to pick kit vs native APIs, add public functions in this repo, and migrate from lodash without inventing helpers kit already has.
